title: DATA-REGIME / SUBSTRATE / SPONTANEITY-vs-COHERENCE frontier deep research

arm1_data_regime.summary: emergence = pre-training loss below a DIVERSE-data threshold (Du arxiv:2403.15796); below a task-DIVERSITY threshold more data only sharpens memorization (Raventos arxiv:2306.15063) — matches anima's measured §11-A FLAT and §16.6-C 'memorization-saturated'. For SPONTANEOUS/agentic behavior, the substrate of differentiation is INTERACTION not a static corpus (Takata arxiv:2411.03252), driven by an intrinsic-motivation self-curriculum that standard LLMs lack (arxiv:2601.12560).

arm2_substrate.summary: §96's SPIKING-INCOMPATIBLE self-attention has a concrete replacement: STDP/plasticity-driven spike-timing routing, softmax-free, addition-only (arxiv:2511.14691, 2503.00226, Spikformer 2209.15425). Liquid Time-constant networks (arxiv:2006.04439) have a NATIVE spontaneous-limit-cycle regime set by weights — and already run on the §95-blessed Loihi-2. Continuous Thought Machines give a GPU-runnable timing-axis proxy.

arm3_spontaneity_vs_coherence.summary: §96's relocated unsolved core. Literature answer: spontaneous activity is coherent BECAUSE it is self-organized-critical (homeostatically structured, Ikeda arxiv:2502.10946) AND because it IS the brain's predictive prior/generative model running (Neuron 2025 S0896-6273(25)00127-8). A predictive learning rule trains coherence in, after which spontaneous replay runs unprompted (eLife 92712).

synthesis: The 4 strongest candidates COMPOSE — they are not independent single-fire moves. C1+C2 fix the data regime (a diverse interaction-loop corpus), C3/C4 supply a substrate that can host continuous spontaneous dynamics, C6 supplies coherence (a predictive learning rule so spontaneity replays LEARNED structure). The arc's recurring pattern — spontaneity is cheap, coherence is the unsolved core — is resolved in the literature only by C6-style predictive learning ON a C1-style diverse corpus. 'What would move the GOAL' is plural: a diverse interaction corpus + a predictive learning rule, on a continuous-dynamics substrate. Every piece is OPEN. None is proven.
